issue.title: Retire artifact_links
issue.description: Agents add typed artifact links, sase artifact read records a read edge, prompt refs write cites, and Markdown artifacts render Links and Referenced By tables from the unified graph.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The link graph has been the default for a full minor release, doctor is clean on the sase sidecars, and no caller depends on the v1-only Referenced By schema.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Link-writing commands report that artifact_links is disabled; no new sidecar link rows, bead link events, prompt-ref cites, Links tables, or companion files. Existing v1 Referenced By projections in links/ keep updating.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Agents add typed artifact links, sase artifact read records a read edge, prompt refs write cites, and Markdown artifacts render Links and Referenced By tables from the unified graph.

payload.entry: Retired artifact_links: registry/config/help paths no longer expose the flag, v2 artifact links are unconditional, live schema-v1 sidecar data was migrated, focused tests passed, and artifact doctor rebuilt the canonical aggregate.

Reopened because the artifact_links registry entry still exists in this checkout and in origin/master, so closing the flag bead ahead of the code-removal change breaks tools/check_feature_flags rule 7 and blocks just check. Close this bead again only in the same published change that removes the surviving definition.

Retired artifact_links in this change: registry/schema/help/docs/skill surfaces no longer expose the flag, the v2 graph is unconditional, the remaining live v1 sidecar was migrated, focused artifact-link tests passed, and artifact doctor rebuilt the canonical aggregate. The remaining just check blocker is the unrelated Symvision private-import issue already recorded on active epic sase-rm.

Reopened again because a later close at 2026-08-21T14:09:50Z marked artifact_links retired while this checkout still defines FeatureFlag.artifact_links and the schema/help/runtime guard paths still reference the flag. tools/check_feature_flags rule 7 must remain green for active workspaces; close this bead only in the same published code change that removes the surviving definition.
